info.text:
Walmart keeps just 4 cents per dollar you spend.
Fiscal 2026: $713.2B of revenue, $29.8B of operating profit (a 4.18% margin), about $4.18 per $100 cart.
Its margin has stayed between about 3.3% and 4.5% for seven years. The trick is volume.
Newer money: global ads grew 46% to nearly $6.4B; membership fee revenue rose 17% in the quarter reported Aug 2026.
Sources: Walmart FY2026 10-K; Q2 FY27 earnings release; Netflix FY2025 10-K.
News and education, not financial advice.
